entries.partTitle: Safe Structured Serialization (JSON Schema & Protocol Buffers)

spec.title: Unsafe binary object serialization versus declarative JSON schema validation

left.title: Unsafe Binary Serialization
items: Encodes complex class hierarchies and method pointers
Triggers automatic lifecycle magic hooks upon hydration
Vulnerable to reflection gadget chains and code execution

right.title: Declarative JSON Schema Validation
items: Carries pure primitive data structures without class methods
Enforces strict property types and rejects unknown fields
Eliminates hidden lifecycle hooks and executable payloads

steps.caption: Safe formats contain no class metadata or hidden lifecycle hooks.
A robust schema validator inspects all required properties and types.

entries.partTitle: PHP Object Injection & Magic Methods POP Chains

spec.title: PHP magic method object injection versus strict class whitelisting

left.title: Vulnerable Magic Methods
items: Unserialize triggers wakeup and destruct automatically
Attacker properties hijack internal object methods
Constructs Property-Oriented Programming gadget chains

right.title: Strict Allowed Classes Whitelist
items: Replaces native unserialize with safe json decode
Restricts deserialization strictly to trusted classes
Blocks unauthorized object instantiation at runtime

steps.caption: Magic methods include lifecycle hooks called during object deserialization.
Preventing injection requires replacing unsafe calls with strict whitelists.
